task.question: After his two-goal performance against Sweden in the France vs Sweden round of 16 match, how many World Cup knockout goals did Kylian Mbappé have in total?
task.evidence: With two goals, Mbappé became the all-time leading goalscorer in World Cup knockout matches with 10 goals.
